26	
27	**Object and scope:** Comparison of experimental vs. theoretical unwrapped phase and magnitude across the common energy range (~23.2–41.8 eV), spanning 99 energy points and 181 emission angles (0–180°).

29	**Relationship:** The mean absolute difference between experimental and theoretical phase (angle-averaged) increases linearly with photon energy at a rate of **0.090 rad/eV** (r² = 0.95, p < 0.001).
